chapter: South America and back in New York
title: A year of vaudeville at Loew's; inspiring Lunceford
summary: He spends about a year in New York playing Loew's vaudeville, including a Great Lakes engagement in Buffalo.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Okay, so now you came back to New York in the Fall of '27.
How long did you stay in New York?
You stayed about a year in New York. Okay, so what --
That's when I played, I was in Loew's State Theater at least four times, because I played it once from the Club Alabam.
So altogether, I played Loew's State about five times, altogether. And one engagement we played in Great Lakes, in Buffalo. That's when I inspired the Jimmie Lunceford orchestra.
